info.name: 02 Roles and Authorities
info.description: Every role on every rule. Run in order: folder 4 creates an employee (newId) that folders 5-7 update, transfer and delete. Users: admin (ADMIN), hana (HR), rita (HR, read only), manoj (MANAGER), asha (USER), hr-sync (permissions, no role).
